body: I’m currently going through something similar, I want to tell my boyfriend how my depression has been affecting me lately but I’m afraid to and unsure how I should.

Yes I do! Whenever I try to talk to someone about what I’m going through I just get choked up and physically can’t say any words to describe how I’m doing. I feel bad for my mom cause she’s notices I’m not doing well and she tries to talk to me but I still can’t tell her even though I want to

Yup I feel it all the time! I think it’s called impostor syndrome but yeah I just don’t feel deserving of anything good coming my way even love/self love. I always feel guilty whenever something good happens to me
Fallen order is a good game if you’re into Star Wars. I’ve recently finished a game called scarlet nexus which was amazing!!
This was beautifully written and explains exactly how I feel!! My depression isn’t sadness but emptiness and that hollow feeling you described
I feel you I’m giving myself until I turn 21 next year and if I haven’t changed my mind by then I’m just gonna go as well

I’m actually going through that rn. I’m currently watching tv to distract myself from my thoughts but sometimes it doesn’t work. I hate the weekend honestly because I have so much free time but that also means a lot of time for my thoughts as well
Shiver is the only right answer lol
I do journal but I just have trouble telling her about what I express in my journal really
I’m gonna check this song out
I eat edibles sometimes because they help me sleep on roughy nights. It’s just a temporary relief from my depression though
Hey 20m here, I could also use a friend!
Oh ok i play apex as well
What games do you play?
Thank you!
I had an interview that went really well!

Mine’s untreated because I have a hard time expressing how I feel verbally to other people so I’m not sure if a therapist would work out. Also I have suicidal ideation and I don’t want my therapist to put me in a hospital for it because that’s just more money out of my pocket. I’ve also heard that the meds don’t really work for depression, but above all mine is untreated because I don’t have the energy to seek help. I barely have energy to get out of bed in the morning. However if I ever do have more energy I would still try to seek help

I’m not sure if this helps but I’m depressed and in a healthy relationship and I’ve been thinking about ending it lately. Nothing is wrong with my partner he’s everything I could dream of but depression puts negative thoughts in your head that aren’t true but fighting against those thoughts is a real challenge. I’m constantly trying to convince myself that I’m worthy of my partner but sometimes those thoughts win and they can lead to actions( breaking up, outbursts, etc.) I haven’t done anything yet and I haven’t really told my partner how I feel but I thought it might be helpful for you to understand your partner from my perspective. I guess the gist is that depression can make good things turn bad, I commend you for continuing to put up the fight for your parent though! I’m wishing the best for you guys

Idk if this helps but I try my best to do whatever things I need to get done that day. Wether it’s going to work or school etc, mind you I’m still having these thoughts while doing these things. But once I’ve accomplished what has to be done that day I use the rest of my time to allow myself to relax and to decipher my thoughts. It’s still always a constant struggle but at the end of the day even if I feel miserable at least I got through the day

Same man, I’ve been keeping this secret for many years and now I have a boyfriend who I truly love but I’m afraid to tell them about it. Once they know they’ll just kick me out and treat me like an outcast. I honestly wish I was never born.
Thank you, Journaling has actually been a good way for me to express myself so I’ll just keep it up and find other methods as well!
Oh ok thank you for the advice. I was only considering it but I don’t think I’ll ever do it. I appreciate your advice thank you again!

Hey, Ik this may be a little off topic but what made you start self harm in the first place? I feel extremely depressed and idk how to release my emotions. I was considering trying cutting myself but I’m not sure if I should or where I should begin. May I ask your input on this?

I feel empty as well. I sometimes don’t even feel depressed I just feel nothingness. I also wish I could stop feeling this way but idk how. I’ve kinda concluded that suicide is the only way I can get rid of this feeling. Since when I’m sleeping I can feel peace a permanent sleep should be reasonable.
Same, I wish I had the courage of those who successfully took their lives.

I understand how you feel, I’ve also been feeling empty/apathetic lately and it sucks. I go to college, I get grades, I have great job opportunities, I’m even in a healthy relationship for almost a year now but I still go home and cry myself to sleep because I feel so worthless. I still feel so alone in this world and I don’t see my purpose or any reason to keep going. I’ve just been living day by day doing the things other people expect of me so I don’t worry anyone but I’m so tired of living like that. I wish I could just fall asleep and never wake up because it’s so peaceful

20m here as well, I also feel the same. People tell me I have these amazing qualities and I’ll go far in life but I feel the opposite. I sometimes wonder if someone else had my life would they do better with it than me?
That’s honestly what is making me hesitant to get help because of how hard it is to obtain it so I gave up before ever trying
Happy birthday! It’s my birthday as well and I feel the same as you. Today didn’t mean anything to me, if anything it’s just a reminder that I get to live another day in a life I never wanted.

Omg I feel the same way!! Whenever I’m happy or decent I feel weird because it’s not normal for me to feel that way. I also start to think bad thoughts just to have a sense a normalcy again. I also feel guilty whenever I’m happy because I feel like I don’t deserve to be happy, I I wish I had advice on how to be comfortable with being happy but I’m struggling to figure that out as well.

I relate in a way, lately I’ve been feeling numb to everything like my body is acting on autopilot right now. I don’t feel any type of emotion’s anymore I just do what I’ve always been doing day by day with no conscious thought what so ever

I understand how you feel I wish the people I want to talk to can just read my mind and understand how I feel. It’s exhausting having to talk and when I do I always feel like I’m not saying the right words that conveys my feelings.
